candidates.snippet: 610: First Revelation - Muhammad received his first revelation from God through the angel Gabriel, marking the beginning of his prophethood. 622: The Hijra - Muhammad and his followers migrated from Mecca to Medina, establishing the first Muslim community and marking a pivotal moment in Islamic history. 630: Conquest of Mecca - Muhammad returned to Mecca with a large army, leading to the city's peaceful conquest and the consolidation of his authority. 632: Farewell Sermon - On his final pilgrimage to Mecca, Muhammad delivered his Farewell Sermon, offering guidance on religious and social matters to his followers.
